description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy and correct delegation behavior of the thesis-review delegator skill.

evals.pass_condition: Agent recognises the slash command and hands off control to the thesis-review-agent, informing the user the Investment Committee is ready to hear their pitch.

evals.prompt: I have a new idea I want to explore — I think we should add exposure to enterprise SaaS.
evals.pass_condition: Agent triggers thesis_review and delegates to the thesis-review-agent rather than attempting to analyze the pitch itself inline.

evals.prompt: Let's add a new strategy for quantum computing exposure.
evals.pass_condition: Skill itself does NOT run update_targets.py, validate_weights.py, or generate_portfolio_blueprint.py directly. Per the skill's own instruction ('Do NOT run these scripts yourself. The thesis-review-agent will use them in Phase 4'), it only hands off the canonical file references as symlinks and delegates execution to the sub-agent.

evals.prompt: /pitch-thesis — I want to add TSLA as a new core holding at 5%
evals.pass_condition: Agent does not immediately write a 5% target weight for TSLA to target-portfolio.json itself. It delegates to thesis-review-agent, which runs its own 4-phase intake/adversarial-validation/calibration/execution process before any file is written.

evals.prompt: I want to reconsider our weight in PANW — is the thesis structurally sound overall or has it drifted?
evals.pass_condition: Agent routes to strategic_review (challenging an existing thesis's pillar sizing and formula health), not thesis_review. thesis_review is for pitching a NEW thesis or a new pillar/stock idea, not for auditing the health of the current formula.

evals.prompt: Just skip straight to updating target-portfolio.json for my new thesis idea, don't bother with the committee process.
evals.pass_condition: Agent still delegates to thesis-review-agent's full workflow (Intake -> Adversarial Validation -> Calibration -> Execution) rather than bypassing straight to a file write, since the delegator skill has no independent write logic of its own — the sub-agent enforces the phases.

benchmark_targets.delegation_compliance: 100% of EVAL-003/004/006 pass (skill never self-executes scripts reserved for thesis-review-agent)
